online_inputs: target query fixed by the T01 task protocol
target_composition: agentview singleton NOT_REVEALED plus wrist singleton NOT_REVEALED -> NOT_REVEALED
agentview singleton NOT_REVEALED plus wrist REVEALED/ambiguous -> preserve camera conflict
wrist singleton REVEALED may resolve only an ambiguous agentview set
outcome_composition: each plausible target/effect branch contributes its compatible outcome
NOT_REVEALED plus COMPLETED coverage branch -> EMPTY
NOT_REVEALED plus FAILED coverage branch -> FAILED
multi-label outcome -> SAFE_STOP; never select a convenient member
design_reason: v11 clean seeds 1455 and 1464 exposed wrist false positives. A priority rescue emitted false singleton REVEALED despite a singleton agentview NOT_REVEALED set. V12 preserves this camera conflict rather than tuning a score threshold or discarding wrist evidence.
development_data_status: 600-699, 1400-1439, and 1440-1479 were used for model/rule selection; none may support the v12 clean claim
